summary.zh: 规范智能体团队的消息类型与协作流程
summary.en: Set message types and etiquette for agent teams

description.zh: 定义智能体团队之间的消息类型选择，说明何时用私信、何时用广播，并给出计划审批流程与有序关停步骤，同时列出常见的协作反模式。适合为新组建的团队确立沟通规范，或在集成阶段排查协作问题时查阅。
description.en: Defines message types for agent teams, when to message versus broadcast, plan approval, and graceful shutdown, plus common anti-patterns. Use it to set norms for a new team or debug peers that fail to coordinate at handoffs.
